chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, raising it, said: Jibraeel (peace be upon him) came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said to him: Indeed your Lord says to you: When you wish to worship Me for a day and night as is the right of My worship, so raise your hands to Me and say:

O Allah, for You is the praise, an eternal praise with Your eternity; and for You is the praise, a praise with no end to it besides Your Knowledge; and for You is the praise, a praise having no extension for it besides Your Desire; and for You is the praise, a praise having no Recompense for its speaker except Your Pleasure.

O Allah, for You is the praise, all of it, and for You is the Favour, all of it, and for You is the Beauty, all of it, and for You is the Light, all of it, and for You is the Might, all of it, and for You is the Grandeur, all of it, and for You is the Magnificence, all of it, and for You is the world, all of it, and for You is the Hereafter, all of it, and for You is the night and the day, all of it, and for You is the creation, all of it, and in Your Hand is the goodness, all of It, and to You do the matters return, all of them, their public and their private.

O Allah, for You is the praise, an everlasting Praise. You are the Good affliction, the One of Majestic Laudation, the concealed Bounty Giver, the Just Judge, the abundant Giver, the Good Rewarder, Lord of the one in the earth and Lord of the ones in the sky.

O Allah, for You is the Praise in the seven mighty (skies), and for You is the Praise in the earth spread out, and for You is the Praise of the endurance of the servants, and for You is the Praise at the times of the afflictions, and for You is the Praise in the mountains (like) pegs, and for You is the Praise in the night when it covers, and for You is the Praise in the day when it brightens, and for You is the Praise in the Hereafter, and the former (life in the earth), and for You is the Praise in the doubles (Imams and the Magnificent Quran.

And Glory be to Allah, and with His Praise, and the earth, all of it would be in His Grip on the Day of Judgment, and the skies would be (like) leaflets in His Right Hand. Glorious is He and Exalted from what they (people) are associating. Glory be to Him and with His Praise. Everything will perish except for His Face. Glory be to You, our Lord, and You are more Exalted, and more Blessed, and Holier.

You Created everything by Your Power, and Compelled everything by Your Might, and Exalted above everything by Your Loftiness, and Overcame everything by Your Strength, and Initiated everything by Your Wisdom and Your Knowledge, and Sent the Rasools with Your Books, and Guided the righteous ones by Your Permission, and Aided the Momineen by Your Help, and Coerced Your creatures by Your Authority.

There is no god except You, Alone. There is no associate for You. Neither do we worship any apart from You, nor do we ask except You, nor do we turn towards except to You. You are the place of (placing) our complaints, and the end-point of our hopes, and (You are) our God and our King.

key_terms.الْمَثَانِي: The Doubles (often referring to the Imams or the Quran)

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for worshiping Allah for a day and night as taught by Jibraeel?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this supplication (Dua) serves as a comprehensive liturgy for total devotion, emphasizing the concept of 'Haqq al-Ibadah' (the right of worship) through exhaustive praise of Allah's attributes. It integrates cosmic imagery and theological affirmations of divine unity (Tawhid), reflecting the Shia tradition of using revealed prayers to align the believer's consciousness with the macrocosm of creation. The text underscores the intercessory role of Jibraeel and the Prophet, highlighting the spiritual efficacy of reciting these specific words for worldly and otherworldly needs.
